title: DRY-RUN FIX — cmd-management/delivery/session/posting.ts: replace all remaining raw manual-posts.jsonl reads with readRealPosts()
changes: cmd-management.ts: cmdHistory, cmdStale, cmdPurge, cmdExport, cmdWeeklyReport, cmdFilmKit, cmdProgress, cmdDedup, cmdTop30, cmdAbResults, cmdStatus, cmdPostPulse — all now use readRealPosts()
cmd-delivery.ts: cmdDeliver, cmdCaptionNext, cmdPostNow, cmdPickup, cmdDeliverNext, cmdQuickstart — all now use readRealPosts()
cmd-session.ts: getNextUnpostedVideo, cmdSession, cmdEndSession — added readRealPosts import, all now use readRealPosts()
cmd-posting.ts: cmdAutoPost queue stats, cmdDashboard, cmdDigest queue section, cmdBatch, cmdPostLog, cmdWeeklyDigest posts section, cmdPostNext — all now use readRealPosts()
root_cause: Commands reading manual-posts.jsonl directly included dry-run entries (browser-post-dry, batch-browser-dry), inflating posted counts and hiding real unposted videos from delivery/queue/gate commands
fix: All commands now use readRealPosts() which filters out dry-run entries. cmdUpdateViews and cmdSetUrl kept using readLines (they do full file rewrites and need all entries).
